remarks: Welcome to this turnkey light-filled home moments from town and train. Featuring gorgeous wide-plank floors, vaulted ceilings, and exceptional finishes throughout. Gracious entry foyer with built-ins effortlessly flows into the spacious living room, complete with vaulted ceilings and a wood-burning fireplace, offering views of the flat, fenced-in yard. The chef's kitchen is a dream, featuring soaring ceilings, stainless steel appliances, and sleek granite countertops. The primary bedroom is a true retreat, offering an updated en-suite bathroom with double sinks, a large walk-in shower, and a soaking tub. Enjoy outdoor living on the beautiful patio, overlooking the private backyard. Located on a desirable cul-de-sac street only minutes to all the best that New Canaan has to offer.
